facts.fact: Tech Africa News, reporting the Sierra Leone government announcement, says Guinea joined the regional effort to address the risk of depending on a single cable connection.
Tech Africa News, reporting the Sierra Leone government announcement, says The Gambia joined the regional effort to address the risk of depending on a single cable connection.
Tech Africa News, reporting the Sierra Leone government announcement, says Liberia joined the regional effort to address the risk of depending on a single cable connection.

The government announcement says a second submarine cable is meant to reduce Sierra Leone's reliance on a single international submarine cable; the second cable, a $45 million project with a new National Cable Consortium, is planned, not in service.
